Faaborg-Midtfyn is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing registry data from the Danish National Patient Registry (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) [^src1]. 

Within the report, Faaborg-Midtfyn is specifically listed in the data tables for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes among atrial fibrillation patients through anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. Its localized performance metrics regarding stroke events and patient denominators are detailed on page 94 [^src1]. Because the available evidence consists solely of this single tabular reference, no further historical, demographic, or additional healthcare details about the municipality are available in this corpus.
